consequence.statement: HelmRepository objects using the source.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1 schema that omit status.artifact.digest are rejected.
consequence.remediation: Before upgrading, check HelmRepository objects (source.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1) for status.artifact.digest and ensure the field is populated so objects are not rejected by the new schema.

original.statement: The source.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1 schema of HelmRepository now requires the field status.artifact.digest, and objects that omit it are rejected.

decision.reason: The CRD validator confirms that status.artifact.digest becomes required in the HelmRepository v1 schema between the two install.yaml artifacts [ev-782bc47d120d] [ev-c2c6c790d6b2]. The computed change text says objects that omit a newly required field are rejected, so resource-rejected (mandatory work) at medium severity is supported. This matches the consequence in known fact vf-6b42bbdfb00a. Confidence is low because the evidence excerpts are only the artifact headers, and nothing in the upstream text describes the runtime effect.
